messages:
Evelyn Ruiz: hey all, first week here — trying to set up Notion. I can view the onboarding playbook but there's no Duplicate or Move options for me. is that expected?
Tom Becker: welcome Evelyn! :tada: Some handbook pages are locked to prevent accidental forks. Which page is it?
Evelyn Ruiz: https://redwood.notion.so/handbook/onboarding-guides/engineering-onboarding
Riley Norman: FYI we default new hires to viewer org role. reach out to docs-rotation to get the docs-editors group if you need to duplicate templates.
Evelyn Ruiz: ok pinged docs-rotation. quick follow-up — where are the canonical templates (PRD, runbook, retro)? i want to duplicate the PRD for a quick draft.
Tom Becker: canonical templates live under /handbook/templates. PRD path: notion://redwood/handbook/templates/product/PRD-v2. Retro and runbook are sibling folders there.
Evelyn Ruiz: should I duplicate into my personal workspace first or create directly in /handbook/drafts?
Riley Norman: duplicate to personal -> flesh out -> move to /handbook/drafts. Then open a docs repo PR referencing the draft page. It lets reviewers comment inline.
Evelyn Ruiz: is there a template naming scheme I should follow when moving drafts?
Tom Becker: yes: prefix with YYYY-MM-team-shorttitle, e.g., 2026-03-product-payment-PRD. Add an "Owners:" line at the top and a one-line summary.
Evelyn Ruiz: any checklist so I don't forget required sections like privacy/PII review?
docs-bot: Reminder: complete the "New hire docs checklist" at /handbook/new-hire-checklist after duplicating templates. It includes privacy, security links, and PR steps.
Evelyn Ruiz: great, and if I need page-level copy turned on for a specific page, who do I ask?
Riley Norman: ping @docs-rotation or @Tom (docs stewardship this week). They'll flip the page copy toggle or add you to docs-editors.
Evelyn Ruiz: thanks everyone! saved me a bunch of time :raised_hands:
